messages:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: SmartRouting fallback rate spike detected for policy=customer_66_smartroute. Fallbacks to region eu-west-1 and variant downgrade seen. 90s window: fallback_rate=18% (>10% threshold), oscillation_count=7. Triggering page to oncall. thread_ts=2410043210

Mira Patel: I'm on it, grabbing context. @Samir can you take page? I need someone to triage model variant compatibility (quant vs fp16) and tool-calling support for this customer.

PagerDuty Bot: Paging Samir Rao (primary oncall) — INC-9812: SmartRouting fallback spike (customer_66).

Samir Rao: Ack. Looking at logs now. Seeing repeated errors: `incompatible_variant: tool_calling_not_supported` followed by `fallback_trigger: region_unavailable` then `variant_negotiation: downgrade_to_quant`. Seems like requests hit a node that serves quantized variant which lacks tool-calling hooks.

Ezra Kim: Copy. Telemetry shows affected endpoints: /v1/chat and /v1/toolcall-proxy. Error rate concentrated on flows with context length > 12k tokens. Suspect the quantized variant was selected for long-context batch path and it doesn't have tool-call ABI.

Mira Patel: Immediate mitigation options? We should avoid customer-visible toolcall failures.

Samir Rao: Proposing hotfix (short): force-route customer_66 to fp16 variant in eu-west-1 until we can fix compatibility matrix. Steps:
1) Update routing override: `redwood route override --customer customer_66 --variant fp16 --region eu-west-1 --ttl 30m`
2) Disable smart-route fallback for this policy: `redwood routing-policy update customer_66_smartroute --smart_fallback false`
3) Enable circuit-breaker for quant variants for this customer: `redwood cb create --customer customer_66 --variant regex:quant.* --threshold 5% --ttl 30m`

Tess Alvarez: If we hard-route to fp16, cost will spike for this customer's traffic. Are CS and sales ok? @Lena (Customer Success) can you confirm outreach threshold?

Lena (Customer Success): We're on call with the customer. They report intermittent tool failures for automated invoice extraction workflows — major blocker for a production job. They prefer availability over cost. Approve hard-route.

Samir Rao: Applying override now. Pasting command output:```
$ redwood route override --customer customer_66 --variant fp16 --region eu-west-1 --ttl 30m
override created: id=ovr-77a3f, applied_to=customer_66, variant=fp16, region=eu-west-1
```

Samir Rao: Also toggled smart_fallback off for that policy. Monitoring metrics. Rolling window error rate dropping from 5.1% -> 0.4% over last 90s.

IncidentBot: Detecting policy change: customer_66_smartroute updated by samir. Observed decrease in fallback oscillation_count to 1.

Ezra Kim: Good. Short postmortem notes: root cause appears to be an out-of-sync compatibility matrix where `quant-llm-x` variants were marked as toolcall-capable for some routing decisions. When capacity pressure hit, smart-router selected quant variants by cost heuristic causing toolcall failures and extra regional fallbacks when quant capacity was saturated. Action items:
- Create immediate test to validate tool-calling ABI on all variants (QA coverage).
- Add compatibility flag guard in smart-router that prevents selecting variants lacking toolcall_support for flows with toolcall=true.
- Investigate why long-context batching preferred quantized variant — anomaly in kernel-selection heuristics.

Mira Patel: Handoff to next rotation: @Tess you're unacknowledged but will take post-incident lead. Summary for handoff: incident started 2410043210, mitigation (hard-route to fp16 + disable smart_fallback) applied 2410043360, error rate rebounded to baseline by 2410043500. Customer impact: 3 customers saw toolcall errors, primary customer_66 had ~1200 rps with ~5% toolcall error over 12m window.

Tess Alvarez: Taking handoff. I'll run the compatibility audit ticket and own the roll-forward plan. Quick checklist I'm picking up:
- Confirm override TTL and schedule extension/rollback plan.
- Open ticket ENG-13654 to add variant compatibility checks to smart-router.
- Coordinate with Eng-Platform to add a canary job verifying toolcall ABI on new quant builds.

Eng-Platform Rotation: Noted. We'll prioritize QA canary; ETA initial patch in 6h, full fix in next deploy. Suggest adding a regression test to the model onboarding flow to catch missing toolcall symbols.

Samir Rao: Final status: mitigation in place, customer ack from Lena: "systems back to normal, thanks" :white_check_mark:. Keeping monitor for 30m then will remove override if stable.

Mira Patel: Thanks team. We'll convert this thread into a postmortem draft (use timeline above). Assigning follow-ups: ENG-13654 (compat guard), ENG-13655 (QA canary), CS-3241 (customer runbook update). Closing comms here unless alerts reappear. :eyes:
